Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Claremont for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events. The glow runs from December 4 (Luminaria Nights at California Botanic Garden) through December 20 (The Living Nativity at Granite Creek Community Church), with the Holiday Promenade and Tree Lighting Ceremony and Santa visits along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Claremont

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Claremont
  • Free: The Living Nativity at Granite Creek Community Church (December 18 to 20, no tickets required)
  • Lights: Luminaria Nights at California Botanic Garden (Fridays and Saturdays, December 4 to 19, $23 adults and $18 children)
  • Meet Santa: Special Needs Santa Meet and Greet, and Santa at the Living Nativity (December 18 to 20)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Holiday Promenade and Tree Lighting Ceremony
  • Trains: no holiday train ride in Claremont (see our California Christmas train rides guide)
  • Season: December 4 to December 20

Planning a bigger day out? Claremont families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Rancho Cucamonga, which covers Victoria Gardens Santa Photos and light shows, Snow Much Fun Day and The Nutcracker.
